HediffDef.label: adamantium skeleton
HediffDef.description: The subject's skeleton has been infused with an indestructible alloy. Limbs and the head cannot be severed; the skeleton will not burn or decay away, enabling regeneration once the fire stops.

HediffDef.label: adamantium claws
HediffDef.description: Retractable adamantium claws are hidden within the subject's forearms. Extending them equips the claws as a melee weapon, while retracting them tears the user's hands.
